g.title: PACK
g.text: MID = junction between lower and upper battery (Midpoint sense point)

g.title: W_HI
g.text: pack+ main (pack → fuse); 2 AWG so the 150 A fuse actually protects the lead

g.title: W_GND
g.text: pack GND to distribution GND (direct, no shunt)

g.title: W_MIDTAP
g.text: high-impedance VBUS tap (midpoint) to the midpoint sense-lead fuse

g.title: SHUNT
g.text: A-B carries main current (high-side, downstream of the fuse); S+/S- are Kelvin sense to INA_PACK

g.title: W_TOBUS
g.text: shunt to distribution V+ (load side; INA_PACK VBUS taps here)

g.title: W_SENSE
g.text: Kelvin sense pair (S+/S-) to INA_PACK IN+/IN-

g.title: INA_PACK
g.text: VBUS senses pack+ at the block; IN+/IN- Kelvin across the shunt

g.title: QW2
g.text: Qwiic/STEMMA-QT daisy chain — Pack to Midpoint

g.title: FUSE_MID
g.text: Fuses the live 12–14 V midpoint sense lead. The MID tap sits UPSTREAM of the 150 A pack fuse, so a chafed/shorted sense wire is otherwise unprotected; a low-amperage inline fuse (0.5–1 A) opens it long before the wire heats.

g.title: W_MIDTAP2
g.text: fused midpoint sense lead (FUSE_MID out) to INA_MID VBUS

g.title: QW1
g.text: Qwiic/STEMMA-QT (GND, V, SDA, SCL) — Mega to Pack. VIN alt = Mega 5V.
